meta.title: A declined vendor can still bid, and the buyer sees both answers at once
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation for the event-level decline described as 'in 057'.
EDGE-BID-017 covers submitting a priced bid after a decline, but does not create the decline state from this setup or perform a complete full-bid flow.
The read_audience shape has no sampled fields, so the plan cannot assert that the vendor row retains the decline text or that the stage lists the vendor as bid placed.
The alternative requirement—either refusing the bid or clearing the decline—is not expressible as an assertion alternative.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
The buyer lists the event's invited vendors.
